name: All In One Custom Login Page Styler – Secure & Fully Customize Your WordPress Login Page
author: Zia Imtiaz

sections.description:
All In One Custom Login Page Styler is the most powerful plugin for fully customizing and securing your WordPress login page. Tailor every element of the login page, add extra security features, and ensure seamless access for your users. This feature-rich plugin helps you personalize the login page with your branding and protects it with advanced security tools.

From customizing logos to limiting login attempts and blocking IPs, All In One Custom Login Page Styler offers everything you need to control access, boost security, and enhance the overall login experience on your WordPress site.

Key Features

1. Complete Login Customization
– Replace the WordPress logo with your own branding.
– Customize background images, colors, and gradients.
– Fully style the login form with advanced options.

2. Enhanced Login Security
– Google reCAPTCHA to prevent bots and brute-force attacks.
– Limit login attempts to block suspicious activity.
– IP and region blocking for greater control.

3. Temporary Login URLs
– Generate time-limited URLs for admin access.

4. Login Logs
– Monitor user login activity, including IP and role tracking.

5. Redirect Management
– Create custom post-login and logout redirection URLs.

6. Passwordless Login
– Secure one-time login links for easy access.

7. Custom Login URL
– Change the default wp-login.php for better security.

Final Words

Secure your site and create a stunning login page with All In One Custom Login Page Styler. Join thousands of happy users today and leave us a review if you love the plugin!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install directly via the WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Login Customization to configure.
sections.faq:
How do I customize my login page?

Visit Login Customization in settings to personalize your page.

How do I enable Google reCAPTCHA?

Add your Site Key and Secret Key in Security Settings.
sections.changelog:
Version 7.1.1

  • New Feature: Added Google reCAPTCHA integration for enhanced login security.
  • Enhancement: Improved IP & Region Blocking functionality for better performance.
  • Fixes: Enhanced login log tracking with detailed user role and location information.
  • Security: Strengthened Limit Login Attempts to combat brute-force attacks more effectively.

Version 6.2

  • New Feature: Added Google Fonts support for advanced font customization.
  • Enhancement: Improved background image handling for mobile responsiveness.
  • Fixes: Addressed minor UI inconsistencies in the login page customizer.

Version 5.3

  • New Feature: Introduced Custom Login URL functionality to enhance security.
  • Enhancement: Updated design tools for better form and button customization.
  • Fixes: Resolved compatibility issues with WordPress 5.0 and newer.

Version 4.2

  • New Feature: Added Login Logs to track login activity, including user IP and roles.
  • Enhancement: Introduced advanced form styling options for more design control.
  • Fixes: Fixed CSS bugs affecting older WordPress versions.

Version 3.1

  • New Feature: Introduced Limit Login Attempts for basic brute-force protection.
  • Enhancement: Optimized plugin performance for faster page load times.
  • Fixes: Minor bug fixes and stability improvements.
